Addresses were discovered via official docs (D2) and audit (D3); direct on-chain reads via defipunkd API were rejected by the allowlist. Recorded as mixed grading basis.

Official deployed contracts doc fetched at https://docs.soniclabs.com/sonic/build-on-sonic/contract-addresses — lists 10 Ethereum Gateway contracts (MPTProofVerifier, StateOracle, ValidatorsRegistry, TokenPairs proxy+impl, TokenDeposit proxy+impl, DirectExitAdministrator, UpdateManager proxy+impl) and 9 Sonic-side contracts. All addresses recorded in admin_addresses.

OpenZeppelin audit fetched at https://www.openzeppelin.com/news/sonic-gateway-audit — scope: Fantom-foundation/Bridge repo at commit 558465d, covering ActivityMonitor, Bridge, DirectExitAdministrator, ExitAdministrator, MPTProofVerifier, MessageBus, MintedERC20, SFCUpdateVerifier, StateOracle, TokenDeposit, TokenPairs, UpdateManager, ValidatorsRegistry. Privileged roles: multisig holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on ExitAdministrator/TokenPairs/UpdateManager; UpdateManager holds admin on ActivityMonitor, StateOracle, ValidatorsRegistry. Quantstamp and Certora reports linked from audits page but not directly fetched this run.

GitHub: Fantom-foundation/Bridge repo identified from OZ audit at commit 558465d. No deployment artifacts (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy JSON) fetched this run — allowlist only permits pre-built surfacer URLs and URLs from prior fetches. GitHub repo URL recorded; commit SHA pinned from audit.

Multi-chain: protocol.chains = Ethereum only (primary scope). Sonic-side contracts (Bridge, StateOracle, TokenPairs, UpdateManager, MPTProofVerifier, ValidatorsRegistry, MessageBus) surfaced from D2 docs but are out-of-scope for this Ethereum-only run; listed with chain=Sonic in admin_addresses for completeness.

Factory pattern: TokenPairs contract acts as a registry mapping original to minted tokens (register function). No factory enumeration read performed — defipunkd API was allowlist-rejected. Recorded in unknowns.

Role taxonomy applied: TokenDeposit (proxy) = vault role; StateOracle = oracle role; UpdateManager = admin role (also controls ValidatorsRegistry/ActivityMonitor/StateOracle); DirectExitAdministrator = guardian role (emergency exit); TokenPairs = other (token registry); MPTProofVerifier = other (proof library); ValidatorsRegistry = other (IBC relay set).

Ratchet integrity: all admin_addresses entries trace to fetched docs URL (evidence index 2) and/or OZ audit (evidence index 3). Multisig addresses holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE were referenced in audit prose but specific 0x addresses were not disclosed in the audit report or docs — recorded as unknowns D8 entries.

protocol_metadata.about: Sonic Gateway is the canonical bridge between Ethereum and the Sonic L1 blockchain, enabling users to deposit ERC-20 tokens (USDC, EURC, WETH, S/FTM) into the TokenDeposit contract on Ethereum, which are then claimable as IOU tokens on Sonic. Bridging the reverse direction involves burning IOU tokens on Sonic, after which users submit Merkle proofs to the Ethereum TokenDeposit to unlock the original assets. Security relies on an off-chain IBC relay network of validators that update Merkle roots on each chain's StateOracle, combined with a fail-safe mechanism that automatically unlocks user funds if the bridge stops transmitting heartbeats for 14 days.
